content:
Sara M: Quick FYI — blog + benchmark went live ~20m ago. Monitor shows early pickup: Hacker News thread and 2 press mentions (TechRadar, AI Weekly). Tagging PR/legal. Need spokesperson + any quote approvals. Short triage?
press-monitor-bot: New mentions detected: TechRadar (score 82): 'Redwood Inference benchmark...' ; AI Weekly (score 74); Hacker News thread id: 304512 — discussion trending. Links: https://techradar.example/rdw-bench | https://aiweekly.example/redwood-bench | https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=304512
Mike R: Thanks. Can you paste the links? I'll start outreach and prepare a brief for reporters. Who is official quote? Kevin ok to comment or prefer technical quote from Jordan?
Jordan P: I can write a tech note quote focused on throughput and cost numbers. Need final numbers from bench report — which we published in the blog. I'll draft now.
Ivy L: Legal: quick check — any embargo breach or pre-arranged exclusives? Need to vet proposed quotes for regulatory language. @Sara M
Sara M: No exclusives. We had an embargo for one outlet but PR pulled it last week; I confirm nothing binding. Links above.
Mike R: Copy. I'll ping TechRadar reporter for a clarifying Q and offer CEO quote. If Kevin is ok, I'll draft an on-the-record CEO line. @Kevin C?
Kevin C: Happy to do a short on-record comment: 'We built Redwood Inference to make predictable LLM serving...' Send me draft.
Jordan P: Draft tech quote: 'These benchmarks show consistent per-token latency reductions with our caching + batching; customers see 2–3x cost improvement vs baseline.' Ivy — OK to use 'customers see' phrasing?
Ivy L: Prefer 'customers reported' instead of 'customers see' — keeps it as reported experience. Also avoid absolute claims. Revised: 'customers reported up to 2–3x lower per-token cost compared to baseline.'
Jordan P: Updated draft per Ivy. Pasting tweet text for social preview — PTAL: 'New blog + benchmark: up to 3x lower per-token cost with smart batching. Read more → [link] #RedwoodInference'
Ellie K: Love it. Suggest we include an image from the media kit and a link to the FAQ. Scheduling window?
Mike R: Propose social push in 30m — coordinate with content for a two-part post (CEO quote + tech quote). I'll start reporter reachouts and flag any outlet requests for exclusives.
press-monitor-bot: Alert: Hacker News thread reached 150 comments, peak traffic in last 10m. Top referrers: r/news, r/MachineLearning. Sentiment: mixed.
Sara M: Thanks everyone. If there's surprise negative framing, we prioritize corrections: Jordan to prepare technical clarifications, Kevin to give high-level context. Mike — please keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
Mike R: Will do. Updating PR tracker now. Tasks: outreach list, media kit link, CEO quote draft, monitor sentiment. I'll post final social text here before scheduling.
Jordan P: Posting short FAQ bullets for press desk — Q1: methodology, Q2: dataset, Q3: comparators. Doc link: https://docs.example/redwood/bench-faq
Ivy L: Reviewed CEO draft and tech quote. Legal approves with small edits (no superlatives). Send final copy for signoff.
Mike R: Final CEO line (edited): 'At Redwood, our goal is predictable, cost-efficient LLM serving. These benchmarks validate the design choices that help teams put models into production.' Approved by @Kevin C.
Kevin C: Looks good. Release on-record.
Ellie K: I'll queue social. Final caption: 'New: Benchmark + blog — real-world serving improvements, up to 3x lower per-token cost reported. Read → [link] #AI #Infrastructure' Scheduling for +35m.
Sara M: Closing loop: PR will handle media, Social will amplify in 35m, Legal has approved. I'll post a short update to #all-hands after the pulse stabilizes. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
